Date: Fri, Mar 6, 2026 at 4:52 AM
Subject: CONFIDENTIAL: RfP for Turkish Police
To: Simon Cheng <s.sagatelecom@gmail.com>
Cc: Taylan ESEN <tesen@angoranetworks.com>


*CONFIDENTIAL*

Hi SImon,
This is one of the biggest RfPs in 2026.
It is Turkish Police and they buy one year’s worth of equipment in 1 RfP.
This year they have issued 3 RfPs.
Please find attached the switch section of each RfP in English and in PDF
format.

This is a very price sensitive, cut throat competition RfP. We have
participated a few times in the past and never won. We need to go with
lowest cost model possible.
This year we have a partner very willing to participate and knows customer
budget and pricing from last years.

I suggest the following route, if that works for you too:

1- Let’s identify the models L2 or L2+ that fully meet the attached
technical specification
2- In the meantime I will provide the quantities
3- There some special requirements as to the packing (including the SFP and
the power supply and even the cables in the same box). So this is a custom
production.
4- Once we identify the models and fully okay on the RfP compliance table,
we can discuss the commercials.

Turkish Police is a very difficult customer, their acceptance is even a
huge problem. We need to be very sure about RfP compliance.

Please shoot any questions over e-mail or WeChat.

Looking forward to hearing back from you soon.

Kind Regards, -Levent.
